text:
sam (Support): Customer reports intermittent 403 when clicking "Generate" in the UI. Happens for a few users in Europe, most recent at 2024-11-01 09:12 UTC. Need minimal repro bundle (HAR + console) + request id so we can correlate with logs. Can we send capture steps to the customer?

jen (DevEx): Yep. Keep it minimal so they actually send it. Ask for: 1) HAR from the failing flow 2) Console logs (errors/warnings) 3) the frontend request-id header (x-request-id) if visible 4) a short note about which button and email/tenant.

sam (Support): Cool. Need a short, copy-pasteable set of steps for non-dev customers.

jen (DevEx): Use this (Chrome is easiest):

1) Open Chrome > three dots menu > More tools > Developer tools (or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I)
2) Click Network tab. Check Preserve log.
3) Reproduce the issue (click Generate).
4) Right-click anywhere in Network table -> Save all as HAR with content.
5) Open Console tab, select any errors, right-click -> Save as... (or copy the visible lines).
6) Before sending: please remove any API key, secret, or personal data from the HAR. We only need the request/response headers and bodies for the failing request.

Pasteable block to send the customer:

```
Steps to collect a minimal repro bundle (Chrome):
1) Open DevTools (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+I).  
2) Network tab -> check "Preserve log".  
3) Reproduce the failure (click the button that errors).  
4) Right-click network table -> "Save all as HAR with content" and attach it.  
5) Go to Console tab -> copy errors (right-click -> Save as or copy the text) and attach.  
6) In the Network tab, click the failing request -> Headers -> look for a header named `x-request-id` (or `x-rw-request-id`) and include that value in the support reply.  
7) Please redact any Authorization/API keys before uploading.  
```

sam (Support): Nice. Add a tiny curl repro template so we can hit it internally if they provide the body & request-id.

jen (DevEx): Sure — remind them to redact API keys and give request-id. Example curl (fill <REQUEST-ID> and paste body):

```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'x-request-id: <REQUEST-ID>' \n  -d '{"input":"REPLACE_WITH_BODY_FROM_HAR"}'
```

Note: If the failing call is proxied through our frontend, include the full request path and method shown in the HAR.

alex (SRE): Also ask them to include the timestamp of the attempt (local time + timezone or UTC) and the approximate client IP if they can. That helps cross-reference our logs. If they can't share IP, request-id + timestamp usually suffices.

sam (Support): What about Safari / Firefox users? Quick steps?

jen (DevEx): Short versions:
- Firefox: DevTools (F12) -> Network -> reproduce -> Right-click -> Save All As HAR. Console -> Web Console -> copy.
- Safari: Preferences -> Advanced -> Show Develop menu. Develop -> Show Web Inspector -> Network -> reproduce -> right-click -> Export as HAR. Console -> Console -> copy.

sam (Support): Good. Any size limits or packaging guidance?

ops-bot: Upload hint: Attach HAR + console text as a single .zip if >5MB. For uploads to the support portal use https://support.redwood.ai/upload (max 100MB). If you need temporary S3 link, let us know.

jen (DevEx): Quick privacy note to add to the customer message: "Please remove Authorization headers or API keys before uploading. You can leave other headers. We're only using the request/response metadata to debug."

sam (Support): I'll send that. Also tell them how to find the request-id in the HAR if they struggle.

jen (DevEx): Right-click the request in Network -> Headers -> Response headers or Request headers -> look for `x-request-id` or `x-rw-request-id`. If not present, open the request payload -> sometimes the client sets `requestId` in JSON body. If they can't find it, ask them to attach the HAR and highlight the failing request path (POST /v1/generate or the exact route).

alex (SRE): If we get the HAR + request-id and still can't find a match, ask for a short screen recording (30s) showing the click + devtools open. Many users find saving HAR confusing; a 30s video is often faster.

sam (Support): Perfect. I'll message the customer with the copy-paste block and ask them to attach the HAR + console + request-id. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder — mark this thread with priority:high if customer impact > 5 users.
